title: WhatsApp chat
stale: Could not refresh. The visible history is preserved.
search: Search by name or phone number

send.validation: Enter a message of up to 4096 characters.

send.forbidden: You no longer have permission for this action.

send.noPhone: WhatsApp did not provide a phone number we can reply to.
send.pending: This conversation has a pending or unconfirmed delivery request.

review.description: Check WhatsApp on the phone: this message may have been sent. It will not be automatically repeated.
review.title: Confirm delivery review
review.confirmDescription: This action enables new replies. It does not send this message again or mark it delivered. Confirm only after checking what arrived on the phone.
review.uncertain: Could not confirm the review. Refresh the chat and check the delivery state before trying again.

leave.title: Leave with unsent replies?
leave.description: Drafts are kept when switching conversations but are lost when leaving this screen.
